articleTitle: Can Metformin Help Low Milk Supply in PCOS?
imageHeadline: When Insulin Resistance Affects Milk Supply
imageSubtext: What research shows about metformin, PCOS, and breastfeeding
pinTitle: Can Metformin Help Low Milk Supply in PCOS? What the Research Shows
pinDescription: If you have PCOS and low milk supply, insulin resistance might be part of the picture. This evidence-based guide explores what the research says about metformin during breastfeeding and whether it may support lactation when other approaches haven't worked.
